title: The model plugin of Qwen3-Next and Qwen3.5 checkpoints, dense and with a mixture of experts
description: A hybrid decoder of gated delta-rule layers and gated softmax attention (an output gate per head, query/key norms, partial rotary positions) with zero-centred RMSNorms (1 + weight), a SwiGLU MLP or a mixture of experts with a gated shared expert, and a multi-token-prediction layer the model drafts from. A finished model plugin: its layout (layout.json) composed by the models core it extends (model-template: the serving contracts, the options) from model techniques.
